description: Three-channel indicator, totaliser and batch controller with RS485: readings, totals, calibration tables, alarms, outputs, display pages and communication settings

sources.title: CTH2265R manual
sources.note: Annex B, registers for RS485 communication

notes: Modbus-compatible RS485, RTU or ASCII, 300 to 9600 bps; functions 3, 4, 6 and 16. Addresses are those of the manual's Annex B (counted from 0).
Floats and doubles are 'CD AB' and 'GH EF CD AB': the low word comes first (word order little).
The 8-bit settings share a register: the manual's LSB is bits 0-7 and its MSB bits 8-15. Not every option list in the manual is complete in this map: the manual abbreviates some lists with '...'.
Registers 4447-4449 and 4578-4593 are reserved ('future use'); reads return an undefined value.
Written from the manufacturer's manual (Portuguese); not tested on a device.
